item.title: Suspected Petah Tikva murder: Victim's husband found nearby, apparently died by suicide
item.description:
New details emerging from the suspected murder of a 43-year-old woman in Petah Tikva indicate that her husband is suspected of killing her.
The husband was found approximately 100 meters from the scene, apparently after taking his own life.

item.title: Democrat Stevens endorses Republican Rogers against El-Sayed in Senate race
item.description:
Rep. Haley Stevens, D-Mich., endorsed Republican Senate candidate Mike Rogers in the race against Democratic candidate Abdul El-Sayed.
"Our Democratic nominee for US Senate, Abdul, said that I was no longer welcome in his campaign and that I should stay away," Stevens said in a video.
“And he’s right, and that’s why I am endorsing Mike Rogers for the United States Senate today," she said. “I don’t belong in Abdul’s campaign."

item.title: Together party to recommend Gadi Eisenkot to form next government
item.description:
Naftali Bennett's Together party will recommend Yashar party chairman Gadi Eisenkot to the President as its candidate to form the next government.
In a statement, the party said the decision was made in accordance with Bennett's promise to respect the will of the voters, adding that Bennett had informed Eisenkot of his decision.

item.title: Election Chief: Foreign funding suspicions won't overturn Israel's vote
item.description: Elections Committee chief Noam Sohlberg says Israel's election results will stand despite serious foreign funding suspicions, as a joint investigation proceeds.

item.title: Who will form Israel's next government? Herzog to begin consultation process
item.description: The President's Office invites Knesset factions for consultations ahead of the decision on whom to task with forming Israel's next government.

item.title: Rabbi Dov Lando's aide leaves door open to supporting Eisenkot
item.description: Rabbi Dov Lando's aide declines to rule out supporting Eisenkot, saying UTJ's future alliances will be determined by the party's rabbinical leadership.

item.title: Coalition talks begin: Knesset factions invited to presidential consultations
item.description: The Director General of the President's Office has invited representatives of the Knesset factions to a round of consultations ahead of the assignment of the mandate to form the next government.

item.title: Tzfat yeshiva shut down over serious fire safety violations
item.description: A yeshiva in Tzfat has been ordered to close for 30 days after an inspection by Israel Fire and Rescue Services uncovered serious fire safety violations

item.title: Arab party leaders to meet to coordinate positions
item.description:
The leaders of Ra'am and the Joint List are expected to meet on Monday for the first time since the elections, aiming to coordinate their positions and political moves with the anti-Netanyahu bloc.
Both parties stated: "We will do everything to replace the Netanyahu government."

item.title: President Herzog to meet Boy George during Israel visit
